task: UI auth routing and mechanic frontend navigation fixes
changes: shared safeInternalPath rejects external/protocol-relative, backslash, control-character and encoded equivalents; canonicalizes harmless dot segments and rejects normalized // paths
dashboardDestination covers all five current roles and uses sign-in fallback when role is absent
expired-session login follows saved MFA password proof before welcome/redirect; non-MFA login verifies server session role
admin login uses a plain MFA URL and checks server session role before announcing admin access; non-admin/null session is cleared
success waits for ready authenticated user, sends signed-out users to sign-in, maps mechanic to /dashboard, and cancels stale redirects
in-progress uses validated intended route or verified role fallback, fetches once per mount and cancels navigation on unmount
failure/in-progress retries enter actual sign-in with a validated returnUrl
mechanic can mount /mechanic and the existing approved /dashboard subset; partner-only pages remain deny-all; mobile logout is reachable; existing plan gate remains
